messages:
sara_support: Hey team — customer ACME reports intermittent 400s and a bunch of 'embedding dimension mismatch' errors on /v1/embeddings when traffic spikes. They also see tail latencies jump to ~2.5s. root request id: r-0a1b2c3d

alex_oncall: thanks, Sara. any pattern on payload sizes or client SDK version?

sara_support: They're on our JS SDK 1.4.0. Typical batch sizes ~40, but request bursts cause dynbatch to coalesce into 60-70 before max_batch_size kicks in. error snippet: `ValueError: expected dim 1536 got 128`

lei_engineer: hmm, sounds like mixed-dimension inputs getting bunched. Could be a client sending legacy small vectors or the SDK serializing incorrectly under burst. Also possible: variant fallback path merging embeddings of different model variants.

maria_prod: we've seen oscillation before when max_batch_size is high + coalesce window is large. If a few legacy requests slip in, dynbatch coalesces them and the dimension check only runs at execution time -> tickets up.

jamie_devx: request: can we get a raw payload example? Also ask customer to upgrade to SDK 1.5.2 (fixes an edge-case where empty `vectors` frames are sent as `[]` instead of omitted).

sara_support: provided a minimal repro payload from their logs (sanitized):
```json
{"model": "embed-1536", "inputs": [[0.1, ... ,0.1], [0.2, ... ,0.2]]}
```
(They truncated, but second item in one batch is 128-d not 1536-d according to their app logs.)

alex_oncall: action plan: 1) ask customer to run a quick curl repro that forces coalesce on staging 2) toggle max_batch_size to 16 in a canary for their org 3) gather server-side trace for the failing requests.

lei_engineer: here's a curl they can run to reproduce locally (forces mixed dims):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"embed-1536","inputs":[[0.1,...(1536 vals)...],[0.2,...(128 vals)...]]}'
```
Note: we'll see `400` with the dim mismatch when coalesced. If the requests hit separately, they'll succeed (one will be rejected earlier).

maria_prod: runtime note: when dynamic batching merges different variants (or sizes) the dimension validation runs just-in-time. We should short-circuit earlier to reduce tail cost and avoid partial execution. I'll open a runtime ticket to add pre-coalesce dimension validation for embeddings route.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Created issue RNW-embed-2041 (runtime pre-coalesce dim validation). Priority: P2. Assignee: lei_engineer.

lei_engineer: quick mitigation for today: 1) set `max_batch_size` lower (e.g., 16) for the customer's route 2) reduce `coalesce_window_ms` to 6ms 3) enable `reject_on_dim_mismatch: true` so bad requests fail fast and do not block batch. Can we do 1 & 3 as a support override?

alex_oncall: I can apply a temporary route config for their org id (org-acme-9) — will set `max_batch_size=16` and `reject_on_dim_mismatch=true` for next 30m. Will report back.

sara_support: I've asked customer to upgrade SDK and run the curl. They reported 401 spikes earlier too (token refresh flow), but that's separate — likely caused retries that increase burstiness.

jamie_devx: good to note the auth churn. If token refresh is aggressive and failing, retries could create flood and exacerbate coalescing. Ask them to check refresh window and exponential backoff.

maria_prod: also check shard distribution — we saw one shard take disproportionate load causing dynbatch to form large batches. I'll pull the shard metrics for their org.

lei_engineer: repro steps for internal: 1) send mixed-dim requests concurrently to embed route 2) observe batch sizes and which requests were accepted into a batch 3) capture runtime logs around `validate_dimensions()` and `exec_batch()` 4) collect trace ids and stack. I'll add a small test script in the ticket.

alex_oncall: update: applied config override for org-acme-9 at 1737654360. Monitoring ingress.

ops-bot: alert: tail-latency for org-acme-9 decreased from 2400ms -> 420ms after override (30s sample).

sara_support: customer ran the upgrade + curl repro. They see immediate 400s but tail latency drops. They confirm SDK 1.5.2 fixed a serialization bug in their env.

jamie_devx: please send me the sample payload and the client-side stacktrace. I'll add a short note in SDK changelog and a snippet to detect mixed dims early in client code.

maria_prod: next steps: - lei to implement pre-coalesce dim validation (RNW-embed-2041) - devx to add client-side quick check example - support to propose lower default max_batch_size for new customers with mixed traffic patterns - product to consider a route-level safety flag `fail_fast_on_dim_mismatch`

lei_engineer: I pushed a small test script to RNW-embed-2041 and started a branch. Will iterate.

sara_support: Thanks everyone — I'll keep the thread open until PR merged and customer confirms stable. :thumbsup:

alex_oncall: closing loop: no billing impact observed (no charge anomalies), auth retry was noisy but unrelated. If customer needs dedicated capacity we can discuss reserved throughput.

ops-bot: thread archived: 1737654321
